mentions.name: Carvera Air G-code expansion board
mentions.description: A G-code controlled expansion board for the Carvera Air that provides 8+8 channels of control for extraction, air assist, vacuum table, timelapse camera, and more, encoding the protocol over the machine's single PWM pin.
mentions.source_excerpt: A gcode controlled expansion board for the Carvera Air that gives you 8+8 channels of control for extraction, air assist, vacuum table, timelapse camera, etc. you only have 1 pwm pin so the protocol encodes over that.
mentions.author: jhogendorn
